title: Reserve VM IDs and addresses
description: Keep your entered IDs and addresses, and reserve values for empty fields. Review the mapping before applying it. Reservations check the selected target and expire after one hour unless renewed.
rangeHint: The range applies to empty VM IDs. Entered IDs remain unchanged. Addresses come from your declared IPv4 /16–/30 subnets; gateways, reserved and visible occupied addresses are skipped.
noHosts: Register a Proxmox host on this backend before reserving resources.
targetMissing: The saved target is unavailable on this backend. Choose a current target and reserve again.
hostPageError: The backend repeated a host page. Reload before choosing a target.
expired: This reservation has expired. Reserve again to check whether these values are still available.
changed: The draft changed after this reservation was checked. Reserve again before applying it.
applied: Reserved values applied. Save the scenario to keep the mapping.
mapping: Reserved VM ID and address mapping
ownershipHint: Reservation ownership stays in this browser and is never saved to Git. Releasing a reservation keeps your entered scenario values. Deployment still runs its own preflight.

errors.ALLOCATION_BUSY: Another reservation changed while this request was checked. Retry with the same draft; this browser will reuse its reservation ownership.
errors.ALLOCATION_OWNERSHIP: This project has an active reservation owned by another browser. Use the original browser or wait for its lease to expire.
errors.ALLOCATION_OCCUPIED: An entered ID or address is occupied. Change that value explicitly, then reserve again.
errors.ALLOCATION_PROTECTED: An entered VM ID is protected. Choose another ID; protected IDs are never reassigned automatically.
errors.ALLOCATION_POOL_EXHAUSTED: The available pool cannot fit this request within the scan limit. Adjust the ID range or declared subnet, or release unused reservations.
errors.ALLOCATION_OCCUPANCY_UNAVAILABLE: Target occupancy could not be checked. Restore the backend connection before reserving.
errors.ALLOCATION_INVALID: Check VM IDs, connected networks and canonical IPv4 subnets in the scenario.
errors.ALLOCATION_EXPIRED: The reservation expired. Reserve again to recheck availability.
